meta.name: azure-app-service
meta.description: Deploy and manage web apps using Azure App Service with auto-scaling, deployment slots, SSL/TLS, and monitoring. Use for hosting web applications on Azure.

copy.tagline: 在 Azure 上部署和管理 Web 应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Azure 上托管 Web 应用并管理部署。
copy.tagline_en: Deploy and manage web apps on Azure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to host web apps on Azure with auto-scaling and deployment management.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能帮你用Azure App Service部署和管理网站，支持自动扩容、零停机更新、SSL证书和监控等。
howto.when: 当你想部署Web应用、REST API或移动后端，或需要管理Azure上的网站时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个Azure App Service来托管我的Node.js网站。
say.note: Claude会执行az命令创建资源组、计划和应用。

say.text: 配置自动缩放规则，让网站流量大时自动扩容。
say.note: Claude会设置基于指标的缩放规则。

say.text: 设置部署槽实现零停机更新。
say.note: Claude会创建部署槽并配置交换操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you deploy and manage web apps using Azure App Service, supporting auto-scaling, zero-downtime deployments, SSL certificates, and monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to deploy web apps, REST APIs, or mobile backends, or need to manage Azure-hosted websites.

say_en.text: Create an Azure App Service to host my Node.js website.
say_en.note: Claude will execute az commands to create resource group, plan, and app.

say_en.text: Configure auto-scaling rules to scale out when traffic increases.
say_en.note: Claude will set metric-based scaling rules.

say_en.text: Set up deployment slots for zero-downtime updates.
say_en.note: Claude will create slots and configure swap operations.
